verdict.rationale: Relay's own marketing says you can create invoices, request payments, and "let Relay handle the follow-up" [relay-docs-5], and it offers built-in invoicing with payment collection [relay-docs-11]. That is a first-party claim of automated invoice follow-up, but it rests on a single marketing line with no detail on how reminders work. Missing for 10: documentation of overdue-specific reminder triggers, configurable reminder schedules or cadence, reminder content or channels, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that automated chasing works.
